name: U.S. Sassuolo Calcio
notes: Sassuolo reports on a calendar year: 2025 covers six months in Serie B (2024-25) and six in Serie A (2025-26). Revenue is total valore della produzione EUR 70,698,440 (includes EUR 15.4m contributions and EUR 2.4m player-sale gains); net loss EUR 38,772,733. Wages/EBITDA come from the reclassified P&L in EUR thousands; evidence quotes the row label. Stake 100% is the sole shareholder ('socio unico') Mapei S.p.A.; the page states sole shareholder, not a percentage. The stadium is in Reggio Emilia, not Sassuolo; its seat counts per stand are shown but the total renders by script, so capacity is left null (not summed). Mapei is controlled by the Squinzi family (Vice president Marco Squinzi, CEO Veronica Squinzi per organigramma) but no page read states the family's holding. No valuation, socials, kit/shirt sponsor roles found. No institutional investors beyond the corporate parent.
